text: {"lessons":["My account value has fallen from 104,609 to 95,738, so I need to evaluate whether each trade improves expected portfolio returns rather than assume activity will help.","I added to several positions at different prices; I should set position limits and avoid increasing exposure without a fresh, evidence-based reason.","I should review each holding against its current outlook and alternatives, not let my purchase price or a recent loss dictate when I buy or sell."]}
